subject: Audit capture scope & temporary customer BYOK carveout request
messages:
From: Nimbus Health <security@nimbushealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit evidence + short-term KMS carveout?

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this call earlier. As discussed, Nimbus is preparing for a time-sensitive audit window and their compliance team is asking if we can provide a targeted evidence package plus a temporary BYOK (customer-provided key) carveout for a small subset of logs (primarily audit-stream events for customer-facing API calls) for a 30-day retention window. Their ask is driven by regulatory proof-of-access requirements for a recent contract.

They supplied a short questionnaire and have flagged the following minimum needs:
- Isolated audit export for the scoped tenant (no cross-tenant contamination)
- KMS-backed blob for the exported window (they prefer to manage keys)
- Proof of log integrity (hashes or signed manifests)
- Timeline: want export and confirmation within 7 business days

I attached their questionnaire and a short summary (Nimbus_SOC2_request.pdf). Can you confirm feasibility and any gating product/ops steps?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Health

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Nimbus Health <security@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence + short-term KMS carveout?

Samir — thank you, received the packet. Looping in Grace (security engineering/product) and Priyom (infra/product ops) to triage.

Quick initial thoughts:
- We can generate an export for the tenant and place it in an isolated bucket (no mixing).
- Temporary BYOK carveout is tricky: our standard BYOK/onboarding pipeline assumes longer-term key lifecycle and additional compliance checks. However, a scoped, time-boxed approach where Nimbus provides a key for an export artifact (not for live serving) may be a reasonable compromise if legal and infra sign off.
- Need to validate whether we can produce signed manifests (we have signing capabilities but need to ensure they meet Nimbus's format).

Requested next steps (short):
1) Grace: confirm product/security constraints and whether signed manifests from our side meet audit integrity needs.
2) Priyom: feasibility of generating an export, accepting a customer-supplied KMS-wrapped object for an export blob, and timeline for a 7-business-day delivery.
3) Nimbus: please confirm the exact log types (api.request, api.response, auth.events) and the tenant IDs in scope.

I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Solutions
Redwood Inference

Cc: Nimbus Health <security@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence + short-term KMS carveout?

Thanks Olga — quick product-level notes after scanning their questionnaire and scope:

Assessment:
- Export: straightforward; we can filter by tenant_id and event types. We'll need a scheduled job to flatten and produce the export window.
- Signed manifests: we can produce SHA256 manifests of the export files; if Nimbus needs an HSM-backed signature we should validate format.
- BYOK carveout: I recommend we treat this as an export-only key ownership model. That is, Nimbus supplies a key we use to wrap the exported artifact at rest in their archive bucket; we do not re-key live data. This minimizes risk and keeps serving unaffected.

Questions for infra/ops (Priyom):
- Can we support wrapping export blobs with a customer-provided key for a one-time export? Any audit/authorization gating?
- Timeline: if infra can accept the request by EOD tomorrow we can schedule the extraction and deliver within the 7-business-day window.

Operational considerations:
- We will add an ops ticket tagged with DEAL-9342 and record the export task with a retention TTL of 30 days.
- Need legal sign-off on temporary key custody language (I can draft an addendum).

I'll draft the export format and a sample manifest and share a Drive link.

Grace O'Connor
Product Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Nimbus Health <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence + short-term KMS carveout?

Hey team — infra ops feasibility notes:

Feasibility:
- We can produce tenant-scoped export artifacts for the requested event classes (api.request, api.response, auth.events) and place them in an isolated bucket.
- For key wrapping: we can accept a customer-supplied public key to encrypt the exported archive; alternatively, Nimbus can provide a KMS-encrypted envelope which we will leave intact when moving into their archive. We cannot integrate a customer-managed key into the live runtime without a full onboarding flow.

Implementation approach (proposed):
1) Create an export job that runs once for the requested window and writes gzipped JSONL files to a staging bucket in the customer folder.
2) Generate SHA256 manifests for each file and sign the manifest using our ops signing key (we'll include signature metadata).
3) Accept Nimbus's provided envelope (they can upload a pre-encrypted envelope blob to the staging location) and we will copy the encrypted blob to their final archive location — we will not attempt to decrypt or re-encrypt.
4) Apply a 30-day TTL on the archive objects and mark the op ticket as completed.

Timeline: 5 business days from approval + key/envelope receipt. Blockers: legal addendum and confirmation of tenant IDs + exact event list.

I've opened OPS-4721 and attached preliminary runbook notes to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nimbus-audit

Priyom Das
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Summary:
- Product and infra agree on an export-only, time-boxed flow. We will not change live-serving keys.
- Deliverable: gzipped JSONL export of api.request/api.response/auth.events for tenant IDs (received from Nimbus), SHA256 manifests, and copy of pre-encrypted envelope provided by Nimbus into their archive. TTL = 30 days.
- Timeline: delivery target = 2027-05-12 (within 6 business days) contingent on Nimbus uploading the envelope and confirming tenant IDs by EOD 2027-05-07.

Action items:
- Nimbus: upload the pre-encrypted envelope to the Drive folder and confirm tenant IDs (Samir).
- Priyom: confirm OPS-4721 runbook and allocate a run window May 10–11.
- Grace: draft the legal addendum and send to legal for a one-paragraph custody statement.
- Aditya: I'm flagging this for potential credit/discount discussion with Revenue — keep an eye on DEAL-9342.
